On node1: 2 pk x 4 x 4 rows, flush per pk; overlapping ck2 range deletes per (pk, even ck1), then ck1 >= 2 per pk, then whole pk0 via ck1 >= 0, flushing between (overlapping range tombstones across sstables); count after each step. Then start node2 + repair, read node2 alone; then node1 alone after major compaction (bypass cache). Guards overlapping range tombstone merging on read, repair and compaction.

Bug: hinted handoff is on (default) while node2 is down, so on node2 restart hints race with repair - the post-repair check passes even if repair fails to ship RTs (deletion_test.py:197-274; repair_additional_test.py disables hints for this reason).
